summary: A line around the padding box: width, style and colour in one shorthand.
details: The style is required; without it there is no border at all. Leave out the colour and the border uses currentColor. border-top, border-bottom and friends set one side only, which is how dividers and underlines are usually made.

values.note: A thin light-grey line: the everyday card border.
Dashed, e.g. for a drop zone.
Two lines; colour follows the text.

gotcha: A border adds to the element’s size unless box-sizing is border-box. To draw a line without changing the layout, use outline or an inset box-shadow instead.
